holdout_card.fact_statement: The iPhone 17 Pro includes the new Dual Capture feature for taking video with both cameras simultaneously.
holdout_card.source_span: The new Dual Capture feature allows the phone to take video with both the front and rear cameras at the same time.

qa_variants.question: What new feature on the iPhone 17 Pro allows users to take video with both the front and rear cameras simultaneously?
qa_variants.source_span: The new Dual Capture feature allows the phone to take video with both the front and rear cameras at the same time.
